hand_authored_note: Hand-curated, version-controlled, --check'd seed of CROSS_DOMAIN_ANALOGUE pairs the orchestration-projection generator reads (the curated_chains / curated_extras idiom of data/command-registry.json). Holds GENERIC framework-NAME pairs ONLY (pws-tier handles) -- never command slugs, never user content, never HSI/embedding-derived over room content (Phase 157 D-02; Canon Part 8). This file is the source for the CROSS_DOMAIN_ANALOGUE edges in the projection. The from/to strings MUST match a framework name in data/command-registry.json or data/connector-registry.json framework_index where one exists, so Wave 3's edges resolve to real framework nodes; the node-derivation union mints a pws-tier framework node for any analogue endpoint, so an endpoint that has no command still gets a legal framework node (the analogue edge never dangles). Seeded with the 150.10 prototype pairs (M4 leverage <-> Reverse Salient Analysis; M3 archetype / find-analogies <-> Four Lenses of Innovation).

analogues.rationale: The Meadows leverage-point move (Systems Thinking M4) is cross-domain analogous to the reverse-salient move: both locate the lagging component in an expanding system where a small, well-placed intervention shifts the whole.

The systems-archetype move (Systems Thinking M3) is cross-domain analogous to the Four Lenses find-analogies move: both recognize a recurring structural pattern in one domain and transpose it as a generative analogy into another.
